t: You're looking at Allies, a sculpture on Bond Street showing Winston Churchill and Franklin D. Roosevelt together. It was made by Lawrence Holofcener, who held both American and British citizenship. The two men matter because of the Second World War. Churchill was British Prime Minister from 1940 to 1945, and Roosevelt was American president from 1933 until his death in 1945. His last two terms centred on US involvement in the war. Here, in bronze, the wartime partners share a bench in the middle of a busy shopping street.
